text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"automation"},"campaign_name":"oer_screen_batch_14_followup","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before follow-up"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0142"},"comment":"re-init same plate, no change"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,20,0,0,10,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"standard Co-Fe-Mn-Ni quaternary, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard anneal profile"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"point_id":17},"comment":"point 17 = deposited spot above"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,25,0,20,0,0,15,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP on same spot as deposited composition (label carried over)"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"point_17","label":"comp_matches_deposit"},"comment":"routine model update with verified label"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,25,0,20,0,0,15,40,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"durability on deposited composition, 1 h standard"}]}
